license.pageSubtitle: Your current edition, capacity usage, and the latest security and update advisories.
license.manager.title: License manager
license.manager.subtitle: Install or replace the signed license on this instance. The license is verified before it is applied.
license.manager.uninstallConfirm: Remove the installed license from this instance? Entitlements change immediately.
license.manager.installHint: Choose your signed license.json. It is verified, then stored and applied immediately — no restart.
license.manager.errorCode.malformed_lice: The license file is missing required fields or is not structured correctly. Check that you uploaded a complete, unmodified license.json.
license.manager.errorCode.invalid_signat: The license signature does not match its contents. The file may be edited or was signed for a different instance. Upload the original license issued to you.
license.manager.errorCode.unknown_key_id: This license was signed with a key this instance does not recognize. Confirm you are using the license issued for this build.
license.manager.errorCode.unsupported_al: This license uses a signature method this build does not support. Update Tessallite or request a compatible license.
license.manager.errorCode.license_expire: This license has expired and cannot be activated. Upload a current, valid license file to replace it.
license.manager.invalidJson: That file is not valid JSON.
license.manager.invalidBody: The installed license failed verification (expired or untrusted signature) and is not active. Upload a current, valid license file to replace it.
license.heading: Edition & capacity

license.manager.loadError: Could not read the license status. Check your connection and retry.
license.invalidBody: The installed license is invalid. It may be expired or its signature is not trusted, so it is not active. Install a current, valid license to activate this instance.
license.expiredBody: The installed license has expired and is no longer active. Contact your administrator or Tessallite to renew or replace the license.
license.manager.expiredBody: The installed license has expired. Upload a current license file to restore full activation.
license.upgradeBody: Need more capacity or enterprise features? Get a license at tessallite.io.

demoReseed.confirmBody: This drops and rebuilds the demo tenant (models, project, aggregates) from the shipped baseline. Your own tenant is not affected.
demoTenant.title: Demo tenant
demoTenant.description: The demo tenant is a standalone, ready-made workspace for showing Tessallite end to end. It is separate from your own tenant — signing in or reseeding it never affects your data.
demoTenant.reseedDescription: Drop and rebuild the demo tenant — project, models, and aggregates — from the shipped baseline. Use this to return the demo to a clean, known state.
accessTokens.title: Personal Access Tokens
accessTokens.description: Personal Access Tokens let you connect BI tools (Excel, Power BI, JDBC/SQL clients) to Tessallite. A token is used in place of a password.
accessTokens.ssoInfo: If you sign in with single sign-on (SAML or OIDC) you have no password to give a BI client. Generate a token here and paste it as the password when connecting Excel or Power BI.
accessTokens.noTokens: You have no personal access tokens yet.
accessTokens.revokeConfirmBody: Revoking "{{label}}" stops it being used for new connections. Any BI session already open ends within a short window. This cannot be undone.
accessTokens.revokeFailed: Failed to revoke the token. Please try again.
accessTokens.createFailed: Failed to generate the token. Please try again.
accessTokens.revealWarning: This is the only time the token is shown. Copy it now and store it securely. You cannot see it again after closing this dialog.
accessTokens.revealUsage: Use this token as the password in your BI client (Excel, Power BI, or any JDBC/SQL client). Your username stays the same. Revoking the token stops new connections; an open session ends within a short window.
errors.form.passwordComplexity: Must be at least 12 characters and include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, and a digit
